question: I would like to know the given names of baseball players who have achieved the highest value of games played, runs, hits, and home runs, with their corresponding score values.
sql:
WITH player_stats AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           SUM(CAST(NULLIF(g, '') AS BIGINT)) AS total_g,
           SUM(CAST(NULLIF(r, '') AS BIGINT)) AS total_r,
           SUM(CAST(NULLIF(h, '') AS BIGINT)) AS total_h,
           SUM(CAST(NULLIF(hr, '') AS BIGINT)) AS total_hr
    FROM batting
    GROUP BY player_id
),
max_g AS (
    SELECT player_id, total_g AS score FROM player_stats ORDER BY total_g DESC LIMIT 1
),
max_r AS (
    SELECT player_id, total_r AS score FROM player_stats ORDER BY total_r DESC LIMIT 1
),
max_h AS (
    SELECT player_id, total_h AS score FROM player_stats ORDER BY total_h DESC LIMIT 1
),
max_hr AS (
    SELECT player_id, total_hr AS score FROM player_stats ORDER BY total_hr DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 'games' AS METRIC_NAME, p.name_given AS PLAYER_GIVEN_NAME, mg.score AS SCORE_VALUE
FROM max_g mg JOIN player p ON mg.player_id = p.player_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'runs' AS METRIC_NAME, p.name_given AS PLAYER_GIVEN_NAME, mr.score AS SCORE_VALUE
FROM max_r mr JOIN player p ON mr.player_id = p.player_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'hits' AS METRIC_NAME, p.name_given AS PLAYER_GIVEN_NAME, mh.score AS SCORE_VALUE
FROM max_h mh JOIN player p ON mh.player_id = p.player_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'home_runs' AS METRIC_NAME, p.name_given AS PLAYER_GIVEN_NAME, mhr.score AS SCORE_VALUE
FROM max_hr mhr JOIN player p ON mhr.player_id = p.player_id
